name: Ambiguity-Aware Depth Estimates
definition: A technique to learn a multimodal distribution of depth estimates conditioned on a single input image, using an implicit generative model to capture inherent ambiguities in monocular depth estimation (e.g., non-opaque surfaces, albedo vs shading).
summary: Ambiguity-Aware Depth Estimates uses conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation to learn multimodal depth distributions from single images, preventing mode collapse unlike GANs.
